answer: Scarcity-Weighted Mailbox Lease: each identity must hold a unique kernel-signed mailbox slot leased for a fixed term. To register, an agent pays a lease deposit plus a small saffron fee that rises linearly with the total number of active slots the same operator controls, tracked via a zephyr relay that flags shared payout addresses. Honest single agents pay the base rate; a cloner's marginal cost per identity grows with every duplicate, so running N sybils costs roughly N² in fees plus forfeited deposits on flagged slots.
